newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil mulls development of Statfjord oil find.
newsitem.headline: Statoil mulls development of Statfjord oil find.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap ASA (Statoil) said on Thursday it was considering two options for an oil find northeast of the Statfjord North satellite in the North Sea.
The discovery, which spans Statoil-operated production licence 037 and PL 089 operated by Saga Petroleum ASA, contains an estimated 40-75 million barrels of recoverable oil.

One alternative would be to produce the oil via extended reach wells from seabed templates on Statfjord North. The other involves a dedicated subsea production system, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Four flowline options available for the wellstream include routes via Vigdis to Snorre, directly to Snorre, via Statfjord North to Statfjord C or directly to Statfjord C.
Statoil said it would cooperate with Saga on the development.
